ScenarioDef.label: Asari revenge
ScenarioDef.description:
After losing their memories, the asari searched for their home for decades, but found no clues. After a while, when they had grown desperate and scattered in all directions, their sensors picked up a strange signal. Alarmed and concerned, they went straight to the epicenter of this signal. It was an ancient artifact of the Protheans, an ancient civilization that perished in the Great Harvest.

The asari, having learned the truth about their past and about the fate of the entire galaxy threatened by the Reapers, decided to join forces and colonize the planet to rise again, restore the good name of a great race and strike back at the approaching threat.
You will play as the asari race.
Make the asari great again!

scenario.summary: Colonize the planet with the asari to rise again, restore the good name of a great race and strike back at the approaching threat. Make the asari great again!
